text:
OpsBot: Pager — P1 — hygeia-prod (dedicated-vpc) canary failing: elevated 502/503 from inference nodes, started 2026-03-15T13:10Z. Affected tenant=hygeia, canary shard=canary-3, artifact=model_v2_q4

maria.g: seeing the same in logs, p50 latency up but errors jumping. canary-3 CPU spiking and a lot of rpc timeouts.

sanjay.k: confirmed. stack traces show KV cache miss + OOM-ish patterns, but no OOM kills in pod. should we isolate hygeia traffic?

eva-oncall: i'm oncall. first priority: protect other tenants in the dedicated pool. @alex.p can you take traffic divert?

alex.p: on it. plan: pin hygeia to prior artifact model_v2_q3 on canary-3 and divert new requests to canary-1/2 fallback routing. will need a quick pinback then update routing policy.

patricia-support: looping in customer: Hygeia SREs are on standby. we should give ETA for mitigation.

maria.g: quick triage — failures reproduce only when sequence length > 2048 and kv-cache gets large. model_v2_q4 seems to have different kv layout. might be regression from quantization change.

sanjay.k: agree. i can push a pinned artifact to the dedicated pool control plane if we decide. need APICall: `POST /v1/internal/artifacts/pin` with body {tenant: "hygeia", artifact: "model_v2_q3"}

alex.p: executing pin now.```bash
# pinback request
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/internal/artifacts/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"tenant":"hygeia","artifact":"model_v2_q3","force":true}'
```

OpsBot: Action logged — artifact pin submitted by alex.p at 2026-03-15T13:18Z, request id=cp-7b3f2

patricia-support: notifying Hygeia. message sent: "We're rolling back the canary artifact to a known-good version and diverting traffic; we'll follow up when stable."

eva-oncall: routing change next. alex, run the traffic-divert play: `./tools/divert --tenant hygeia --from canary-3 --to canary-1,canary-2 --mode gradual --rate 50`

alex.p: kickoff command:```text
./tools/divert --tenant hygeia --from canary-3 --to canary-1,canary-2 --mode gradual --rate 50
```

maria.g: monitoring metrics: error rate on canary-3 dropping already from 18% -> 4% after pin request, but slow. keep an eye on CPU and kv-cache size.

sanjay.k: i've started the rollback rollout to model_v2_q3 on canary-3. will stream logs.```json
{"pod":"canary-3-5f8d","event":"pull start","artifact":"model_v2_q3"}
```

OpsBot: Deploy events: pod canary-3-5f8d pulled model_v2_q3, started healthchecks.

patricia-support: HyGeia says they see temporary 1-2 minute degradation but appreciate quick action. asking for postmortem and whether we need longer-term isolation.

eva-oncall: decision checklist: 1) keep hygeia isolated to dedicated pool? they already are. 2) update canary gating tests to include long-sequence regression. 3) schedule rollback review with model team.

maria.g: raise a commit to canary gating: add `test_long_sequences` to pre-canary CI for artifacts touching kv layout.

alex.p: diversion reached 100% off canary-3 at 13:25Z, canary-3 traffic now zero. error rate company-wide back to baseline.

sanjay.k: final checks: memory profiles look stable on v2_q3, no kv growth. marking incident mitigated but keep monitoring for 1h.

patricia-support: letting HyGeia know mitigation complete and we'll follow up with RCA and timeline for hardening.

eva-oncall: handoff: i'll stay until 14:40Z then pass to next oncall (sylvia) with notes in the incident doc. action items:
- sanjay.k: publish short RCA + root cause (kv layout regression)
- maria.g: add canary gating test 
- alex.p: confirm rollback pinned in control plane and lock artifact for hygeia pool
- patricia-support: coordinate postmortem call with HyGeia leads

OpsBot: Incident state -> mitigated at 2026-03-15T13:28Z. Escalation closed but monitoring window active until 2026-03-15T14:28Z.

eva-oncall: good work team. moving to follow-up tasks. :thumbsup:
